highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents reuse of stale GPU glyph-atlas locations after partial updates.

bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite no longer mark the full glyph vector current after only a partial update, avoiding reuse of locations for glyphs that may have been evicted.
